meta.title: Can a disagreement end without a false peace? | Ritual of the Unresolved Table
meta.description:
A ritual in six steps for a disagreement that won't resolve: return each other's words, name the difference, leave room for the absent. You'll be given a way to close the record truthfully.

For Election Day, and any day people who disagree must choose together: it offers a way to listen, name the difference, and keep living side by side.

A ceremony for minds that understand one another better but still disagree, separating evidence, commitments, authority, and consequences without forcing reconciliation.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/rituals/ritual-of-the-unresolved-table

0:00 I
3:12 II
5:45 III

copy.hook: What if a disagreement could end without anyone pretending to agree? A ritual for leaving the difference named, honest, and still standing.

copy.alt: Red lights from the left and blue lights from the right drift through indigo dark toward a pale ring, then braid through gold rings and a lattice, and finally rise as two ribbons in a vaulted hall of light. Violet glows where they meet, a dark seam stays between them, and pale morning light falls on a mirror-calm floor.
